name: Victory for the Alliance
label: Quest
description: Victory for the Alliance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to the Highlord.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of Stormwind restored! Today, we celebrate this glorious victory!
